source.author: ov
source.text: Sternuntur segetes et deplorata coloni vota iacent, longique perit labor irritus anni.
source.text_original: Sternuntur segetes et deplorata coloni / vota iacent, longique perit labor irritus anni.
source.text_english: The crops are laid low, and the farmers’ prayers, doomed to sorrow, lie fallen; and the futile labor of the long year perishes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_original: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, / strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_english: All the grove of the god groans with rapid wings; Ceres is laid low, and the black sea is stirred beneath the swift bird.
